source.name: Toyota Warranty and Maintenance Guide
source.note: Read from the maintenance chart in Toyota's guide for the 2026 RAV4 Hybrid, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the guide that came with your own vehicle.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of the maintenance chart in Toyota's own Warranty and Maintenance Guide for the 2026 RAV4 Hybrid (T-MMS-26RAV4HV), which Toyota publishes free. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
